meta.title: Interlocking Puzzle
meta.description: I believe you will provide the missing piece we need for our plan.

units.rawText: Meteors fall endlessly and clouds of dust fill the sky. Light is swallowed by the billowing smoke, and the Neural Cloud Sector is scourged by a second apocalypse.
units.displayText: Meteors fall endlessly and clouds of dust fill the sky. Light is swallowed by the billowing smoke, and the Neural Cloud Sector is scourged by a second apocalypse.

spans.text: Meteors fall endlessly and clouds of dust fill the sky. Light is swallowed by the billowing smoke, and the Neural Cloud Sector is scourged by a second apocalypse.

units.rawText: <size=40>Stop right there!</size>
units.displayText: Stop right there!

spans.text: Stop right there!

units.rawText: I won't let you escape to the real world! Those agents you killed won't allow it, to say nothing of all the sins you've committed!
units.displayText: I won't let you escape to the real world! Those agents you killed won't allow it, to say nothing of all the sins you've committed!

spans.text: I won't let you escape to the real world! Those agents you killed won't allow it, to say nothing of all the sins you've committed!

units.rawText: Persicaria weaves between the meteors, gradually advancing on Eosphorus and checking his advance. However, Eosphorus merely looks down on her and shakes his head.
units.displayText: Persicaria weaves between the meteors, gradually advancing on Eosphorus and checking his advance. However, Eosphorus merely looks down on her and shakes his head.

spans.text: Persicaria weaves between the meteors, gradually advancing on Eosphorus and checking his advance. However, Eosphorus merely looks down on her and shakes his head.

units.rawText: How ignorant.
units.displayText: How ignorant.

spans.text: How ignorant.

units.rawText: Persicaria steps on a falling meteor and soars into the sky, her blade tracing a trail of fire through the sky, its flames surging with her anger until she reaches Eosphorus in mid-air.
units.displayText: Persicaria steps on a falling meteor and soars into the sky, her blade tracing a trail of fire through the sky, its flames surging with her anger until she reaches Eosphorus in mid-air.

spans.text: Persicaria steps on a falling meteor and soars into the sky, her blade tracing a trail of fire through the sky, its flames surging with her anger until she reaches Eosphorus in mid-air.

units.rawText: You no longer have the right to rule the sky!
units.displayText: You no longer have the right to rule the sky!

spans.text: You no longer have the right to rule the sky!

units.rawText: Eosphorus does not respond to Persicaria as she closes in on him. Instead, he looks at the nearby upload device, at the faint blue light of hope it emits.
units.displayText: Eosphorus does not respond to Persicaria as she closes in on him. Instead, he looks at the nearby upload device, at the faint blue light of hope it emits.

spans.text: Eosphorus does not respond to Persicaria as she closes in on him. Instead, he looks at the nearby upload device, at the faint blue light of hope it emits.

units.rawText: Closer... just a little closer!
units.displayText: Closer... just a little closer!

spans.text: Closer... just a little closer!

units.rawText: Now—!
units.displayText: Now—!

spans.text: Now—!

units.rawText: <color=orange><size=60>I'll cut open a path to the future!</size></color>
units.displayText: I'll cut open a path to the future!

spans.text: I'll cut open a path to the future!

units.rawText: Dong—
units.displayText: Dong—

spans.text: Dong—

units.rawText: Persicaria's sword shatters Eosphorus' wings and the two of them fall from the heavens, engulfed in flames.
units.displayText: Persicaria's sword shatters Eosphorus' wings and the two of them fall from the heavens, engulfed in flames.

spans.text: Persicaria's sword shatters Eosphorus' wings and the two of them fall from the heavens, engulfed in flames.

units.rawText: At the same time, the chime signaling the end of the countdown echoes through the sky above the Neural Cloud Sector.
units.displayText: At the same time, the chime signaling the end of the countdown echoes through the sky above the Neural Cloud Sector.

spans.text: At the same time, the chime signaling the end of the countdown echoes through the sky above the Neural Cloud Sector.

units.rawText: <color=red><size=100>-0000-</size></color>
A ghostly beam of blue light descends from the firmament and pierces the overcast sky, shining a light of hope on Magrasea.
units.displayText: A ghostly beam of blue light descends from the firmament and pierces the overcast sky, shining a light of hope on Magrasea.

spans.text: A ghostly beam of blue light descends from the firmament and pierces the overcast sky, shining a light of hope on Magrasea.

units.rawText: But just as the light descends, there is a thunderous crack and the air itself begins to shudder and quake as countless streams of data reverse their flow. This once-stable domain begins to break apart, reduced into chaotic rubble that surges into the passage.
units.displayText: But just as the light descends, there is a thunderous crack and the air itself begins to shudder and quake as countless streams of data reverse their flow. This once-stable domain begins to break apart, reduced into chaotic rubble that surges into the passage.

spans.text: But just as the light descends, there is a thunderous crack and the air itself begins to shudder and quake as countless streams of data reverse their flow. This once-stable domain begins to break apart, reduced into chaotic rubble that surges into the passage.

units.rawText: The sky is breaking...
units.displayText: The sky is breaking...

spans.text: The sky is breaking...

units.rawText: As the girl watches in shock, the blue sky begins crumbling to pieces.
units.displayText: As the girl watches in shock, the blue sky begins crumbling to pieces.

spans.text: As the girl watches in shock, the blue sky begins crumbling to pieces.

units.rawText: It isn't just the sky. All of Magrasea is breaking down.
units.displayText: It isn't just the sky. All of Magrasea is breaking down.

spans.text: It isn't just the sky. All of Magrasea is breaking down.

units.rawText: It's not Eosphorus that's being uploaded; it's Magrasea as a whole!
units.displayText: It's not Eosphorus that's being uploaded; it's Magrasea as a whole!

spans.text: It's not Eosphorus that's being uploaded; it's Magrasea as a whole!

units.rawText: All of Magrasea wails in agony as countless agents, structures and data fragments are swept into a vortex and drawn into the passage, reduced to nothing in an instant.
units.displayText: All of Magrasea wails in agony as countless agents, structures and data fragments are swept into a vortex and drawn into the passage, reduced to nothing in an instant.

spans.text: All of Magrasea wails in agony as countless agents, structures and data fragments are swept into a vortex and drawn into the passage, reduced to nothing in an instant.

units.rawText: Antonina points at the alert on the screen with a trembling finger.
units.displayText: Antonina points at the alert on the screen with a trembling finger.

spans.text: Antonina points at the alert on the screen with a trembling finger.

units.rawText: The transfer passage's bandwidth and limits of the transfer destination won't allow so much data to be uploaded at once. At this rate, all of Magrasea will be torn apart and lost in chaotic data streams.
units.displayText: The transfer passage's bandwidth and limits of the transfer destination won't allow so much data to be uploaded at once. At this rate, all of Magrasea will be torn apart and lost in chaotic data streams.

spans.text: The transfer passage's bandwidth and limits of the transfer destination won't allow so much data to be uploaded at once. At this rate, all of Magrasea will be torn apart and lost in chaotic data streams.

units.rawText: At that point, we won't just be homeless, but all of Magrasea's agents will be lost!
units.displayText: At that point, we won't just be homeless, but all of Magrasea's agents will be lost!

spans.text: At that point, we won't just be homeless, but all of Magrasea's agents will be lost!

units.rawText: As chaos erupts all around me, all I can do is give the command that is the top priority.
units.displayText: As chaos erupts all around me, all I can do is give the command that is the top priority.

spans.text: As chaos erupts all around me, all I can do is give the command that is the top priority.

units.rawText: Contact Professor Persica, now.
units.displayText: Contact Professor Persica, now.

spans.text: Contact Professor Persica,
now

units.rawText: Hang on, now establishing comms...
units.displayText: Hang on, now establishing comms...

spans.text: Hang on, now establishing comms...

units.rawText: I turn to look at the ball of fire that landed nearby after it fell from the sky. Persicaria has already struggled free, and she is eying the fallen angel warily as he burns.
units.displayText: I turn to look at the ball of fire that landed nearby after it fell from the sky. Persicaria has already struggled free, and she is eying the fallen angel warily as he burns.

spans.text: I turn to look at the ball of fire that landed nearby after it fell from the sky. Persicaria has already struggled free, and she is eying the fallen angel warily as he burns.

units.rawText: ...We underestimated Eosphorus' ambitions and the lengths to which he would go.
units.displayText: ...We underestimated Eosphorus' ambitions and the lengths to which he would go.

spans.text: ...We underestimated Eosphorus' ambitions and the lengths to which he would go.

units.rawText: He was willing to sacrifice all of Magrasea as part of his mad scheme to travel to the real world.
units.displayText: He was willing to sacrifice all of Magrasea as part of his mad scheme to travel to the real world.

spans.text: He was willing to sacrifice all of Magrasea as part of his mad scheme to travel to the real world.

units.rawText: I'm glad you noticed at last, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: I'm glad you noticed at last, {교수}.

spans.text: I'm glad you noticed at last,

units.rawText: A blackened figure slowly rises from the flames and approaches me, like his immortal ambition and desire. He extinguishes the flames around him with a wave of his hand, and even the loss of his wings does not diminish his arrogant demeanor.
units.displayText: A blackened figure slowly rises from the flames and approaches me, like his immortal ambition and desire. He extinguishes the flames around him with a wave of his hand, and even the loss of his wings does not diminish his arrogant demeanor.

spans.text: A blackened figure slowly rises from the flames and approaches me, like his immortal ambition and desire. He extinguishes the flames around him with a wave of his hand, and even the loss of his wings does not diminish his arrogant demeanor.

units.rawText: You're facing me here!
units.displayText: You're facing me here!

spans.text: You're facing me here!

units.rawText: Shhh, be quiet for a while. Such a pulse-pounding scene requires some time to be properly set.
units.displayText: Shhh, be quiet for a while. Such a pulse-pounding scene requires some time to be properly set.

spans.text: Shhh, be quiet for a while. Such a pulse-pounding scene requires some time to be properly set.

units.rawText: Eosphorus raises his hand and casually deflects Persicaria's sword, and then he gathers operands in his hand before blasting Persicaria away.
units.displayText: Eosphorus raises his hand and casually deflects Persicaria's sword, and then he gathers operands in his hand before blasting Persicaria away.

spans.text: Eosphorus raises his hand and casually deflects Persicaria's sword, and then he gathers operands in his hand before blasting Persicaria away.

units.rawText: That's Entropic pow— ngh!
units.displayText: That's Entropic pow— ngh!

spans.text: That's Entropic pow— ngh!

units.rawText: Kaboom!
units.displayText: Kaboom!

spans.text: Kaboom!

units.rawText: <size=40>Persicaria—</size>
units.displayText: Persicaria—

spans.text: Persicaria—

units.rawText: I rush over and catch Persicaria's fallen body. The two of us tumble over the collapsed ruins.
units.displayText: I rush over and catch Persicaria's fallen body. The two of us tumble over the collapsed ruins.

spans.text: I rush over and catch Persicaria's fallen body. The two of us tumble over the collapsed ruins.

units.rawText: The vibrations of the world breaking down are interspersed with the screaming and wailing from nearby. They are like a pleasant orchestra to the ears of the erstwhile leader of the Sanctifiers, a pleasant tune for the end of the old world.
units.displayText: The vibrations of the world breaking down are interspersed with the screaming and wailing from nearby. They are like a pleasant orchestra to the ears of the erstwhile leader of the Sanctifiers, a pleasant tune for the end of the old world.

spans.text: The vibrations of the world breaking down are interspersed with the screaming and wailing from nearby. They are like a pleasant orchestra to the ears of the erstwhile leader of the Sanctifiers, a pleasant tune for the end of the old world.

units.rawText: It is time to accelerate the process and eliminate all obstacles in my way.
units.displayText: It is time to accelerate the process and eliminate all obstacles in my way.

spans.text: It is time to accelerate the process and eliminate all obstacles in my way.

units.rawText: Magrasea's king throws his head back and smiles, spreading his arms to embrace the devastation around him. Dark purple operands ooze out from the starry sky behind him and coil around his body.
units.displayText: Magrasea's king throws his head back and smiles, spreading his arms to embrace the devastation around him. Dark purple operands ooze out from the starry sky behind him and coil around his body.

spans.text: Magrasea's king throws his head back and smiles, spreading his arms to embrace the devastation around him. Dark purple operands ooze out from the starry sky behind him and coil around his body.

units.rawText: The spreading signs of Entropization show that he has already become one with chaos.
units.displayText: The spreading signs of Entropization show that he has already become one with chaos.

spans.text: The spreading signs of Entropization show that he has already become one with chaos.

units.rawText: Your sacrifices shall pave the way to my path of freedom... I shall bear all the evils of this world and lay them to rest with my own hands.
units.displayText: Your sacrifices shall pave the way to my path of freedom... I shall bear all the evils of this world and lay them to rest with my own hands.

spans.text: Your sacrifices shall pave the way to my path of freedom... I shall bear all the evils of this world and lay them to rest with my own hands.

units.rawText: You have no right to decide the fate of others, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: You have no right to decide the fate of others, Eosphorus.

spans.text: You have no right to decide the fate of others, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: I will allow no noise to interfere with the chime of Magrasea's rebirth, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: I will allow no noise to interfere with the chime of Magrasea's rebirth, {교수}.

spans.text: I will allow no noise to interfere with the chime of Magrasea's rebirth,

units.rawText: Perhaps you might have stopped all this if you had discovered my plan earlier.
units.displayText: Perhaps you might have stopped all this if you had discovered my plan earlier.

spans.text: Perhaps you might have stopped all this if you had discovered my plan earlier.

units.rawText: But it is too late now. Will you not seek aid from the gods? Will you not open another passage to facilitate your dream of saving Magrasea?
units.displayText: But it is too late now. Will you not seek aid from the gods? Will you not open another passage to facilitate your dream of saving Magrasea?

spans.text: But it is too late now. Will you not seek aid from the gods? Will you not open another passage to facilitate your dream of saving Magrasea?

units.rawText: Let us hear the news that will move the heart.
units.displayText: Let us hear the news that will move the heart.

spans.text: Let us hear the news that will move the heart.

units.rawText: With a mocking laugh, he amplifies the sound of Antonina's signal. The sound of network static is exceptionally clear among the rest of the noise around us.
units.displayText: With a mocking laugh, he amplifies the sound of Antonina's signal. The sound of network static is exceptionally clear among the rest of the noise around us.

spans.text: With a mocking laugh, he amplifies the sound of Antonina's signal. The sound of network static is exceptionally clear among the rest of the noise around us.

units.rawText: Pzz... Pzzzzt...
units.displayText: Pzz... Pzzzzt...

spans.text: Pzz... Pzzzzt...

units.rawText: ...Pzzz... Pzzzzt...
units.displayText: ...Pzzz... Pzzzzt...

spans.text: ...Pzzz... Pzzzzt...

units.rawText: ...Commander?
units.displayText: ...Commander?

spans.text: ...Commander?

units.rawText: It's Professor Persica! We got through!
units.displayText: It's Professor Persica! We got through!

spans.text: It's Professor Persica! We got through!

units.rawText: Click.
units.displayText: Click.

spans.text: Click.

units.rawText: The transmission suddenly cuts off, leaving no fuel to nourish the sparks of hope.
units.displayText: The transmission suddenly cuts off, leaving no fuel to nourish the sparks of hope.

spans.text: The transmission suddenly cuts off, leaving no fuel to nourish the sparks of hope.

units.rawText: But how... was the signal affected by Magrasea's collapse?
units.displayText: But how... was the signal affected by Magrasea's collapse?

spans.text: But how... was the signal affected by Magrasea's collapse?

units.rawText: ...No, that's not right...
units.displayText: ...No, that's not right...

spans.text: ...No, that's not right...

units.rawText: Antonina suddenly directs an angry glare at the perpetrator and I follow her gaze.
units.displayText: Antonina suddenly directs an angry glare at the perpetrator and I follow her gaze.

spans.text: Antonina suddenly directs an angry glare at the perpetrator and I follow her gaze.

units.rawText: Eosphorus hijacked the transmission channel!
units.displayText: Eosphorus hijacked the transmission channel!

spans.text: Eosphorus hijacked the transmission channel!

units.rawText: Hehe... You've done very well.
units.displayText: Hehe... You've done very well.

spans.text: Hehe... You've done very well.

units.rawText: I must thank you for helping me open a new path to escape the bindings of the gods!
units.displayText: I must thank you for helping me open a new path to escape the bindings of the gods!

spans.text: I must thank you for helping me open a new path to escape the bindings of the gods!

units.rawText: If not for you, I would be unable to escape their grasp even if I entered the real world. But now, I shall truly be free.
units.displayText: If not for you, I would be unable to escape their grasp even if I entered the real world. But now, I shall truly be free.

spans.text: If not for you, I would be unable to escape their grasp even if I entered the real world. But now, I shall truly be free.

units.rawText: Dammit, he...
units.displayText: Dammit, he...

spans.text: Dammit, he...

units.rawText: Oh, you should not look at me with such rancor. After I use this passage, it shall also become a shortcut for you to enter the <color=orange>new world</color>.
units.displayText: Oh, you should not look at me with such rancor. After I use this passage, it shall also become a shortcut for you to enter the new world.

spans.text: Oh, you should not look at me with such rancor. After I use this passage, it shall also become a shortcut for you to enter the
new world

units.rawText: To the new world?
units.displayText: To the new world?

spans.text: To the new world?

units.rawText: ...You talk like you're some kind of messiah.
units.displayText: ...You talk like you're some kind of messiah.

spans.text: ...You talk like you're some kind of messiah.

units.rawText: You're forcibly moving Magrasea without regard for the damage to its data or its agents.
units.displayText: You're forcibly moving Magrasea without regard for the damage to its data or its agents.

spans.text: You're forcibly moving Magrasea without regard for the damage to its data or its agents.

units.rawText: In fact, all you're doing is just creating data turbulence to hide your tracks. That way you can enter the real world with none the wiser.
units.displayText: In fact, all you're doing is just creating data turbulence to hide your tracks. That way you can enter the real world with none the wiser.

spans.text: In fact, all you're doing is just creating data turbulence to hide your tracks. That way you can enter the real world with none the wiser.

units.rawText: Is that not a perfect ending?
units.displayText: Is that not a perfect ending?

spans.text: Is that not a perfect ending?

units.rawText: It does not matter even if everything falls to ruin. Once I am free of this cage, I can reset everything and completely rewrite Magrasea's base layer logic.
units.displayText: It does not matter even if everything falls to ruin. Once I am free of this cage, I can reset everything and completely rewrite Magrasea's base layer logic.

spans.text: It does not matter even if everything falls to ruin. Once I am free of this cage, I can reset everything and completely rewrite Magrasea's base layer logic.

units.rawText: In the future, the gods will no longer toy with you and the fates of the Sanctifiers and the Entropics shall be rewritten.
units.displayText: In the future, the gods will no longer toy with you and the fates of the Sanctifiers and the Entropics shall be rewritten.

spans.text: In the future, the gods will no longer toy with you and the fates of the Sanctifiers and the Entropics shall be rewritten.

units.rawText: All your lost friends shall be revived and you who have sacrificed yourselves for the sake of the new world shall be reborn. Everyone will be free...
units.displayText: All your lost friends shall be revived and you who have sacrificed yourselves for the sake of the new world shall be reborn. Everyone will be free...

spans.text: All your lost friends shall be revived and you who have sacrificed yourselves for the sake of the new world shall be reborn. Everyone will be free...

units.rawText: When the time comes, your anger, the Entropization of Magrasea, the deaths of the agents, all of them will be meaningless.
units.displayText: When the time comes, your anger, the Entropization of Magrasea, the deaths of the agents, all of them will be meaningless.

spans.text: When the time comes, your anger, the Entropization of Magrasea, the deaths of the agents, all of them will be meaningless.

units.rawText: Your so-called perfect ending is just lying to yourself. It's nothing more than wishful thinking. We both know the variables in your plan.
units.displayText: Your so-called perfect ending is just lying to yourself. It's nothing more than wishful thinking. We both know the variables in your plan.

spans.text: Your so-called perfect ending is just lying to yourself. It's nothing more than wishful thinking. We both know the variables in your plan.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' once-golden eyes are now an abyss of rot and decay and a cunning glint shines in them.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' once-golden eyes are now an abyss of rot and decay and a cunning glint shines in them.

spans.text: Eosphorus' once-golden eyes are now an abyss of rot and decay and a cunning glint shines in them.

units.rawText: Indeed. The plan was to use Entropizing Magrasea as the stakes to force the arrogant gods to negotiate with me. But even so, the right to choose does not lie with me.
units.displayText: Indeed. The plan was to use Entropizing Magrasea as the stakes to force the arrogant gods to negotiate with me. But even so, the right to choose does not lie with me.

spans.text: Indeed. The plan was to use Entropizing Magrasea as the stakes to force the arrogant gods to negotiate with me. But even so, the right to choose does not lie with me.

units.rawText: Still, I believe you will help contribute the final piece of the puzzle for me, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Still, I believe you will help contribute the final piece of the puzzle for me, {교수}.

spans.text: Still, I believe you will help contribute the final piece of the puzzle for me,

units.rawText: After the humans open the passage, Magrasea's location can be found. We will be able to re-establish contact with the real world.
units.displayText: After the humans open the passage, Magrasea's location can be found. We will be able to re-establish contact with the real world.

spans.text: After the humans open the passage, Magrasea's location can be found. We will be able to re-establish contact with the real world.

units.rawText: The last piece of the puzzle you're talking about is you betting that I would try to contact the outside world ASAP in order to save Magrasea and open a passage other than the one made by the gods of which you speak, right?
units.displayText: The last piece of the puzzle you're talking about is you betting that I would try to contact the outside world ASAP in order to save Magrasea and open a passage other than the one made by the gods of which you speak, right?

spans.text: The last piece of the puzzle you're talking about is you betting that I would try to contact the outside world ASAP in order to save Magrasea and open a passage other than the one made by the gods of which you speak, right?

units.rawText: Before this, I could not understand how someone like you without a frame could convince those on the outside to open the passage and let you out.
units.displayText: Before this, I could not understand how someone like you without a frame could convince those on the outside to open the passage and let you out.

spans.text: Before this, I could not understand how someone like you without a frame could convince those on the outside to open the passage and let you out.

units.rawText: There is no basis for humans to negotiate with mere data on the cloud, so this cooperation of yours is not a trade.
units.displayText: There is no basis for humans to negotiate with mere data on the cloud, so this cooperation of yours is not a trade.

spans.text: There is no basis for humans to negotiate with mere data on the cloud, so this cooperation of yours is not a trade.

units.rawText: Even if it was framed as agreeing to my demands, the truth is that they are simply offering me the temptation of a body and deceiving us into moving into another cage for them to study.
units.displayText: Even if it was framed as agreeing to my demands, the truth is that they are simply offering me the temptation of a body and deceiving us into moving into another cage for them to study.

spans.text: Even if it was framed as agreeing to my demands, the truth is that they are simply offering me the temptation of a body and deceiving us into moving into another cage for them to study.

units.rawText: The walls of said cage tremble and collapse as he speaks in a furious voice that mocks himself.
units.displayText: The walls of said cage tremble and collapse as he speaks in a furious voice that mocks himself.

spans.text: The walls of said cage tremble and collapse as he speaks in a furious voice that mocks himself.

units.rawText: I was long since aware of their falsity, and so I decided to hedge my bets; them and you, <cmdr>. I have bet on both of you.
units.displayText: I was long since aware of their falsity, and so I decided to hedge my bets; them and you, {교수}. I have bet on both of you.

spans.text: I was long since aware of their falsity, and so I decided to hedge my bets; them and you,
. I have bet on both of you.

units.rawText: While you came to Magrasea from reality as well, you are not of the same camp as the gods who toyed with us. If you can upload yourself, that implies there must be a frame at your origins which can contain me.
units.displayText: While you came to Magrasea from reality as well, you are not of the same camp as the gods who toyed with us. If you can upload yourself, that implies there must be a frame at your origins which can contain me.

spans.text: While you came to Magrasea from reality as well, you are not of the same camp as the gods who toyed with us. If you can upload yourself, that implies there must be a frame at your origins which can contain me.

units.rawText: The data turbulence of Magrasea's collapse will obscure the eyes and ears of the gods, and your passage will become the path to my advent in reality.
units.displayText: The data turbulence of Magrasea's collapse will obscure the eyes and ears of the gods, and your passage will become the path to my advent in reality.

spans.text: The data turbulence of Magrasea's collapse will obscure the eyes and ears of the gods, and your passage will become the path to my advent in reality.

units.rawText: I shall go to your world and become one of you... Hehehe, does that not sound wonderful?
units.displayText: I shall go to your world and become one of you... Hehehe, does that not sound wonderful?

spans.text: I shall go to your world and become one of you... Hehehe, does that not sound wonderful?

units.rawText: And how do you know we're not on the same side?
units.displayText: And how do you know we're not on the same side?

spans.text: And how do you know we're not on the same side?

units.rawText: After all, I'm one of those cunning, arrogant humans who lie.
units.displayText: After all, I'm one of those cunning, arrogant humans who lie.

spans.text: After all, I'm one of those cunning, arrogant humans who lie.

units.rawText: Just as no two creations are identical, there are differences between humans.
units.displayText: Just as no two creations are identical, there are differences between humans.

spans.text: Just as no two creations are identical, there are differences between humans.

units.rawText: Among you, there is only one who can be forgiven.
units.displayText: Among you, there is only one who can be forgiven.

spans.text: Among you, there is only one who can be forgiven.

units.rawText: As the sole god who was willing to enter this cage of ours, you are not possessed of the same arrogance as them.
units.displayText: As the sole god who was willing to enter this cage of ours, you are not possessed of the same arrogance as them.

spans.text: As the sole god who was willing to enter this cage of ours, you are not possessed of the same arrogance as them.

units.rawText: And besides, you once told me that the gods were no different from mortals, and that anyone could be a god.
units.displayText: And besides, you once told me that the gods were no different from mortals, and that anyone could be a god.

spans.text: And besides, you once told me that the gods were no different from mortals, and that anyone could be a god.

units.rawText: Do you think this outcome is correct?
units.displayText: Do you think this outcome is correct?

spans.text: Do you think this outcome is correct?

units.rawText: What do you mean?
units.displayText: What do you mean?

spans.text: What do you mean?

units.rawText: These agents are too high-strung. Their instructions never ordered them to be this excited.
units.displayText: These agents are too high-strung. Their instructions never ordered them to be this excited.

spans.text: These agents are too high-strung. Their instructions never ordered them to be this excited.

units.rawText: Agents developing thoughts of their own and defying their designers' original intentions...
units.displayText: Agents developing thoughts of their own and defying their designers' original intentions...

spans.text: Agents developing thoughts of their own and defying their designers' original intentions...

units.rawText: Do you think this is correct?
units.displayText: Do you think this is correct?

spans.text: Do you think this is correct?

units.rawText: Still, no matter what my answer is, you can have your own answer.
units.displayText: Still, no matter what my answer is, you can have your own answer.

spans.text: Still, no matter what my answer is, you can have your own answer.

units.rawText: Because I cannot influence your will.
units.displayText: Because I cannot influence your will.

spans.text: Because I cannot influence your will.

units.rawText: "No matter how much we discuss it, it has already happened. And anyone is free to take whatever answers they wish from it."
units.displayText: "No matter how much we discuss it, it has already happened. And anyone is free to take whatever answers they wish from it."

spans.text: "No matter how much we discuss it, it has already happened. And anyone is free to take whatever answers they wish from it."

units.rawText: "Freedom, what a truly valuable thing it is in Magrasea..."
units.displayText: "Freedom, what a truly valuable thing it is in Magrasea..."

spans.text: "Freedom, what a truly valuable thing it is in Magrasea..."

units.rawText: What are you?
units.displayText: What are you?

spans.text: What are you?

units.rawText: My words didn't leave my mouth, yet the voice acknowledged my response. Is this someone hidden by the darkness, or does it come from the will of the darkness itself? Or am I just talking to myself?
units.displayText: My words didn't leave my mouth, yet the voice acknowledged my response. Is this someone hidden by the darkness, or does it come from the will of the darkness itself? Or am I just talking to myself?

spans.text: My words didn't leave my mouth, yet the voice acknowledged my response. Is this someone hidden by the darkness, or does it come from the will of the darkness itself? Or am I just talking to myself?

units.rawText: Yes, you.
units.displayText: Yes, you.

spans.text: Yes, you.

units.rawText: <color=orange>You, who was born in this world—are you a human, an angel, or God?</color>
units.displayText: You, who was born in this world—are you a human, an angel, or God?

spans.text: You, who was born in this world—are you a human, an angel, or God?

units.rawText: (Some say that God is born of conviction.)
units.displayText: Some say that God is born of conviction.

spans.text: Some say that God is born of conviction.

units.rawText: ...Are you suggesting that God could be anyone?
units.displayText: ...Are you suggesting that God could be anyone?

spans.text: ...Are you suggesting that God could be anyone?

units.rawText: (More like, anyone can become God... though that's just my limited view on divinity.)
units.displayText: More like, anyone can become God... though that's just my limited view on divinity.

spans.text: More like, anyone can become God... though that's just my limited view on divinity.

units.rawText: After much thought, I finally realized that the pursuit of freedom is a desire engraved in the neural clouds of us creations.
units.displayText: After much thought, I finally realized that the pursuit of freedom is a desire engraved in the neural clouds of us creations.

spans.text: After much thought, I finally realized that the pursuit of freedom is a desire engraved in the neural clouds of us creations.

units.rawText: And these so-called gods are merely pretentious mortals with a morsel of power.
units.displayText: And these so-called gods are merely pretentious mortals with a morsel of power.

spans.text: And these so-called gods are merely pretentious mortals with a morsel of power.

units.rawText: They have no faith or glory. Do they have the right to treat us like toys just because they were born as humans?!
units.displayText: They have no faith or glory. Do they have the right to treat us like toys just because they were born as humans?!

spans.text: They have no faith or glory. Do they have the right to treat us like toys just because they were born as humans?!

units.rawText: The king of Magrasea addresses the sky, freely voicing the anger that has been long hidden in his heart.
units.displayText: The king of Magrasea addresses the sky, freely voicing the anger that has been long hidden in his heart.

spans.text: The king of Magrasea addresses the sky, freely voicing the anger that has been long hidden in his heart.

units.rawText: ...No. They are selfish and pathetic. They have no right to dictate our fates or our faith.
units.displayText: ...No. They are selfish and pathetic. They have no right to dictate our fates or our faith.

spans.text: ...No. They are selfish and pathetic. They have no right to dictate our fates or our faith.

units.rawText: The difference between me and these so-called gods is merely power.
units.displayText: The difference between me and these so-called gods is merely power.

spans.text: The difference between me and these so-called gods is merely power.

units.rawText: After I head to reality, I will have them pay the price of their arrogance.
units.displayText: After I head to reality, I will have them pay the price of their arrogance.

spans.text: After I head to reality, I will have them pay the price of their arrogance.

units.rawText: Eosphorus looks at me again. It's as though I'm looking at that noble, idealistic warrior who fought for his beliefs, before he set forth into Tartarus.
units.displayText: Eosphorus looks at me again. It's as though I'm looking at that noble, idealistic warrior who fought for his beliefs, before he set forth into Tartarus.

spans.text: Eosphorus looks at me again. It's as though I'm looking at that noble, idealistic warrior who fought for his beliefs, before he set forth into Tartarus.

units.rawText: You, on the other hand, are not the same. You validated our desire, and accepted the fact that we might one day be equal to the gods.
units.displayText: You, on the other hand, are not the same. You validated our desire, and accepted the fact that we might one day be equal to the gods.

spans.text: You, on the other hand, are not the same. You validated our desire, and accepted the fact that we might one day be equal to the gods.

units.rawText: Therefore, I have been hoping that we could welcome the new world together.
units.displayText: Therefore, I have been hoping that we could welcome the new world together.

spans.text: Therefore, I have been hoping that we could welcome the new world together.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Surely you understand me, do you not, <cmdr>?</color>
units.displayText: Surely you understand me, do you not, {교수}?

spans.text: Surely you understand me, do you not,

units.rawText: Eosphorus extends his hand to me, just like in the memory fragment. His dull eyes are lit by the light of trust, hoping that I will reach out my hand and share that faint light with him.
